sheets.title: Daily Tracker
values: DAILY TRACKER  ·  Routine, Nutrition, Hydration, Sleep & Activity
Fill the yellow columns each day — grey columns calculate themselves.

HOW TO USE  ·  Yellow cells are yours: columns C-G take Y or N, H-L take numbers, M is free text. Everything grey is a formula — do not type over it. "Habits Met" counts the 5 Y/N habits plus the water and sleep targets, so the Daily Score is out of 7. A day at or above the Great Day Threshold extends your streak. Rates divide by days you actually logged, so skipping a day never counts against you. Dates come from Settings — change them there, not here.

sheets.title: Finance Tracker
values: FINANCE TRACKER  ·  Expense Ledger, Categories & Daily Budget Control
Log every purchase on the left. The day-by-day budget on the right calculates itself.
Within budget — 100.00 QAR left this month

HOW TO USE  ·  Add one row per purchase in the yellow columns — as many rows a day as you like. Category and Payment Method are dropdowns. The home-currency amount, share of total and the whole day-by-day block on the right calculate themselves. A day above the daily limit shows OVER; "Budget Left" turns red once the month's spend passes that month's allowance (daily limit x days in the month). Use "Life & Finance ▸ Add expense" for a quick mobile-friendly entry form.

sheets.title: Salary & Savings
values: SALARY & SAVINGS  ·  Income, Money Sent Home and Savings Rate
Expenses pull automatically from the Finance Tracker ledger. Yellow cells are yours.

HOW TO USE  ·  Yellow columns are yours: Salary (filled from the Monthly Salary on Settings once each month starts — type over any month that differs), Other Income, and money Sent Home. Expenses pull month by month straight from the Finance Tracker, so you never retype them. Remittance is treated as SAVINGS, not spending — money sent home still belongs to you, it has just moved. Flip "Remittance counts as savings" to N in Settings if you would rather subtract it. The TOTAL row counts only months that have actually started, so it never reports unearned future salary as money saved.

sheets.title: Weekly Summary
values: WEEKLY SUMMARY  ·  Habits and Spend, Week by Week
Weeks run from the Start Date in Settings. Everything here is calculated — nothing to fill in.

Weekly Budget = Daily Spend Limit x the days that week actually covers, so a short final week is not judged against a full seven days. Variance is budget minus actual: green is money left over, red is an overspend. A week with nothing logged shows blank rather than 0%, so an untouched week never reads as a failed one.

sheets.title: Monthly Summary
values: Every figure is calculated from the Daily Tracker, Finance Tracker and Salary & Savings sheets.

Habit percentages are "days marked Y" divided by "days you logged that habit", so skipping a day does not punish the rate. A month with nothing logged shows blank, not 0%. Income, Net Savings and Savings Rate mirror the Salary & Savings sheet.
